purpose: Test whether a newly inventoried resolved-BCG dynamics host also supplies independent, observable-level strong-lens constraints over the same radial support. This is an acquisition and identifiability test, not a gravity fit.
selection_blinding: A2261 was selected because it independently appears in the 32-host Loubser dynamics source and the 20-system CLASH sample. No gravity residual or alternative-theory fit was inspected.

distance_conversion.origin: Coe et al. 2012 states 1 arcsec approximately 3.59 kpc at z=0.225 in its declared cosmology
distance_conversion.role: radial-support bookkeeping only; it is not a gravity target

dynamics_support.origin: typical one-sided support stated for the Loubser et al. radial profiles

lens_sources.primary_catalog: Coe et al. 2012, ApJ 757, 22, CDS J/ApJ/757/22 table3
lens_sources.catalog_redshift_policy: Use only the starred best-isolated arc's photometric redshift and its published asymmetric 95-percent interval as the family-level independent redshift summary. For family 4, replace the photometric summary by the later MOSFIRE spectroscopic redshift z=3.377 from Rydberg et al. 2017.
forbidden_as_input: published NFW or other mass-profile summaries
counterimage positions predicted by a lens model

failure_policy: Keep the catalog as a valid CLASH observable acquisition, but do not promote A2261 to the same-system response sample, fit a Weyl response, infer a mass map, or relax the 15-kpc overlap requirement.
